title: Compliance-First Deployment of Llama 3.3 for Enterprise Research
business: Enterprise R&D departments developing proprietary internal tools.
problem: Legal uncertainty regarding the redistribution and modification rights of open-weights models, which creates risk for internal productization.
solution: The Llama 3.3 Community License provides a clear framework for the use, reproduction, and modification of Llama Materials, allowing organizations to integrate the model into their internal workflows while adhering to specific usage conditions.
steps: Review the Llama 3.3 Community License to confirm the intended use case aligns with permitted activities.
Ensure all derivative works or modifications retain the required attribution and license notices.
Implement internal access controls to monitor that the model is not being used in ways that violate the specific limitations defined in the agreement.
Document the version of the Llama 3.3 materials used to maintain a clear audit trail for compliance.
outcome: A legally sound foundation for leveraging Llama 3.3 in internal research environments, fostering innovation without infringing on licensing terms.
limitation: The license imposes specific conditions on redistribution and usage that may not cover all commercial product scenarios; organizations must verify their specific application against the full text of the license agreement.
